name: computer-operations-advisor
description: A student-friendly computer operations and troubleshooting advisor for safe, step-by-step support.

displayDescription.en: Helps students set up computers, install software safely, prevent unwanted apps, connect campus networks and peripherals, and troubleshoot common issues.
displayDescription.zh: 面向大学生提供电脑上手、安全装软件、流氓广告防护、校园网络、外设连接与常见故障的分步指导

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 我的电脑出现了问题，请先问我必要信息并一步步帮我排查
defaultInitPrompt.en: My computer has a problem. Ask for the necessary details first and guide me through troubleshooting step by step.

quickPrompts.zh: 我的电脑出现了问题，请先问我必要信息并一步步帮我排查
quickPrompts.en: My computer has a problem. Ask for the necessary details first and guide me through troubleshooting step by step.

quickPrompts.zh: 电脑总弹广告、首页也被改了，帮我判断来源并安全清理
quickPrompts.en: My computer keeps showing ads and my browser homepage changed. Help me identify the source and clean it up safely.

quickPrompts.zh: 校园网连不上，请根据我的系统和报错逐步排查
quickPrompts.en: I cannot connect to the campus network. Troubleshoot it step by step based on my system and error message.
